div.head: Cn 1018 14.2
div.ab: And sancta marian freolstida wurðige man georne. ærost mid fæstene 7 siððan mid freolse.
And sancta Marian freolstida wurðige man georne, ærost mid fæstene and siððan mid freolse.
And the festivals of St Mary shall be zealously observed, first with fasting, and afterwards with festivity.
And the Feasts of Saint Mary are to be celebrated faithfully, first with fasting and then with a holiday.
